name: @opengroow/template-validator
description: Validate OpenGroow Template packages and hub indexes with the reader the product uses at installation

scripts.build:
esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/cli.js "--banner:js=#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && chmod +x dist/cli.js
